539:t_014:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$フィアナ$$... Don't tell me...!」

539:t_014:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now that's some rare happy news!」

539:t_014:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That fact alone made coming here worthwhile.」

539:t_014:11.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll crush whoever twisted $$フィアナ$$'s fate and mine.」

539:t_015:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Today the $$マーティアル$$ Church... God... will perish.」

539:t_015:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「For the future of $$フィアナ$$ and me.」

539:t_016:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We have confirmed the destruction of the $$マーティアル$$ Church.」

539:t_016:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They may have been victims too, ruled by someone who falsely used the name of God...」

539:t_016:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And the man who refused to bow to that was $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, I suppose.」

539:t_017:2.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! Scan for enemies!」

539:t_017:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't be so thick. Leave it be.」

539:t_017:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Just as I thought, you guys still have a long way to go.」

539:t_017:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$フィアナ$$... I'm coming now.)

539:t_018:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn! My $$エクルビス$$ can't hold out any longer!!」

539:t_018:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「B-but if I lose this thing, I can't carry on as a mercenary!」

539:t_019:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it! $$キリコ$$! $$シャッコ$$, $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! And $c, too!!」

539:t_019:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Remember this! Someday I'll make you all understand my greatness!」

539:t_020:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「It looks like his AT exploded.」

539:t_020:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「What happened to $$カン・ユー$$!?」

539:t_020:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Who knows. That man is a tough one. He may well be alive.」

539:t_020:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Either way, I don't care. If he shows up as an enemy again, we'll just meet him head-on.」

539:t_020:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You never got your reward to the very end, $$カン・ユー$$.」

539:t_021:0.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「You who denied my existence... will surely regret it...」

539:t_021:1.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「You... cannot overcome the future of despair. In the true... collapse that comes once every 120 million years, the universe... all of spacetime... will vanish... completely!」

539:t_021:2.en:
$$桂$$
「For a guy who called himself a god, he's one pretty pessimistic gentleman.」

539:t_021:3.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Primordial... Singularity. You... cannot overturn that fate...」

539:t_021:4.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「If there is one who... can repair this warped spacetime... then that one... is...」

539:t_021:7.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「$$キリコ$$... You will regret... not accepting me...」

539:t_021:8.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「What awaits you... is a future of despair.........」

539:t_022:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Looks like what the $$集合無意識$$ told us was for real after all...」

539:t_022:3.en:
$$桂$$
「I've got no intention of obeying a guy who toys with other people's lives and fates. Us included... and $$キリコ$$, too.」

539:t_022:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$... This world has no need of you.)

539:t_022:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Neither I nor my comrades will ever obey the likes of you. Even if you are called a god...)

539:t_100:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$! The time has finally come!」

539:t_100:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Come to think of it, our feud has dragged on for a long time... And it ends here!」

539:t_100:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「With my victory, of course!」

539:t_100:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Begging and crying for mercy is too late now! You went too far, $$キリコ$$! Prepare yourself!」

539:t_100:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

539:t_100:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm coming through, $$カン・ユー$$. I have no business with you.」

539:t_100:7.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you bastard! I thought you'd finally said my name, but you're going to make a fool of me right to the very end!」

539:t_101:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$カレン$$! Has the time come to settle things with you too!」

539:t_101:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「You're relentless, $$カン・ユー$$! To me you're nobody who matters at all!」

539:t_101:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「But hey! If you're going to get in $$キリコ$$'s way, I'll be your opponent!」

539:t_101:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「I've got a few grudges against you, after all!!」

539:t_101:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you...! You'd bring personal feelings onto the battlefield!」

539:t_101:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's you talking like you're above all that that pisses me off!!」

539:t_102:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$... Even if I defeat you, the fight between $$フィアナ$$ and me probably won't end...)

539:t_102:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Then we will keep fighting. Beyond the despair you speak of...)

539:t_103:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ワイズマン#pilot$$, who falsely claims to be a god... Because of you, the image inside me has gradually been taking clearer shape.)

539:t_103:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But can we, as we are now, do it? Overcome the future of despair...)

539:t_104:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$, you freak of power...! The arrogance of you who claim to be beyond human cannot be forgiven!」

539:t_104:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Brave warriors of $$クエント$$! Lend me the strength to strike him down!」

539:t_105:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even if you called yourself a god, you were nothing but a vulgar man trying to rule others.」

539:t_105:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It just means you were still too early to climb the stairs to God.」
